answer_body: Reinstating parental rights after a Termination of Parental Rights (TPR) order in Wisconsin is procedurally complex and rare, but relief may be possible depending on how the termination occurred. Challenging a TPR order typically requires demonstrating significant procedural defects, lack of due process, or filing an appeal within strict statutory deadlines.
